findings.title: Failed device-limit checks are cached as successful tags
findings.body: The cache entry is written before `CreateOrUpdateDevice` is attempted, but it is not removed when that call fails. When a device is rejected because the limit is reached, its next authentication attempt hits this cache entry and returns nil without checking the store. `Authenticate` then allows that anonymous session through, so the device limit can be bypassed by retrying.

findings.title: Concurrent inserts can exceed the configured device limit
findings.body: The device count and the subsequent insert/update are separate database operations with no lock or transaction protecting the limit. If multiple requests arrive while the count is below the limit, they can all observe the same count and insert distinct devices, exceeding the configured cap. Enforce the limit atomically with the insert or serialize these operations.
